# Appeal of Denial — Total Shoulder Replacement (CPT 23472)

**Member:** Avery Hayes
**Member ID:** W379220601
**Plan:** Humana (Commercial/ACA), Georgia
**Denial date:** 2026-08-07
**Reference number:** POC-47F0C5AA4B-91233

To the Grievances and Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of my request for a total shoulder replacement (CPT 23472). My denial notice, dated 2026-08-07, states that this determination "was made under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria," but it does not name that policy or quote any specific criteria. Because I have not been given the actual language the plan used to evaluate my case, I cannot fully respond to it here — and I am asking, in the section below, that it be provided to me in writing.

## Why I am appealing

The stated reason for denial is that the documentation submitted was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I believe the records already in my file address this. My surgeon, Dr. Duval, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary, and the following facts are part of my prior authorization packet:

- I have had 14 months of progressive shoulder pain that has not improved with rest.
- I completed 16 weeks of supervised physical therapy focused on rotator cuff strengthening and scapular mechanics (24 visits, 2026-02-20 through 2026-06-12), documented in my physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for 8 months without adequate relief, and received a corticosteroid injection on 2026-03-19 that gave only 4 weeks of partial relief.
- An MRI of my shoulder on 2026-07-08 showed a full-thickness supraspinatus tear measuring 1.8 cm with grade 2 fatty atrophy.
- I am unable to lift my arm above shoulder height or sleep on the affected side.
- On exam, I have positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.
- There is no active infection and no untreated substance use noted in my chart; my BMI is 29, and I am a non-smoker.

I have not been quoted any specific plan criteria in my denial notice, so I am not able to state here exactly which requirement the plan believes is unmet. What I can say is that the documentation above — imaging, exam findings, conservative treatment history, and functional limitations — appears to cover the categories that are typically required to support medical necessity for this procedure. If the plan's criteria require something different or additional, I am asking that this be identified specifically so it can be addressed.

## Request for the plan's written criteria

I am requesting that Humana provide me, in writing, the specific medical policy and clinical review criteria that were applied to deny this request, including the policy title, number, and version in effect on the date of review. The plan holds this information, and I am entitled to see the standard my case was measured against so that I can respond to it directly.

## What I am asking for

I ask that this denial be reconsidered in light of the clinical documentation described above, and that Humana issue a new determination taking that documentation into account. If any additional records or forms are needed from my surgeon's office to complete this review, please let me know specifically what is missing so it can be submitted promptly.

I understand my appeal must be received by 2027-02-03. I will confirm the correct mailing address on my denial notice and send this appeal there; I understand the form is also available at resolutions.humana.com/grievances-appeals-forms, and that expedited requests can be made by phone at 1-800-867-6601 or the number on my member card.

Thank you for reconsidering my request.

Sincerely,

______________________________
Avery Hayes
Member ID: W379220601
Date: [date of signature]
Contact phone: [phone number]
Contact address: [mailing address]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*

evidence.criteria_request: Humana's criteria ARE public but they don't give any policy a permanent web address - links expire within hours. Open the search page and click the title for your surgery ('Knee Arthroplasty - Medicare Advantage', 'Knee Arthroscopy - Medicare Advantage', 'Shoulder Arthroscopy - Medicare Advantage'; change docbegin=H for hip, =S for shoulder). Save the PDF as soon as it opens.
